_comment: Human-readable restatement of what is frozen. NOT the runner's manifest.json (which is compared with this file after each run; any frozen value that differs is reported as a deviation). Hash formats: case_order_sha256 = sha256('\n'.join(ids)) with no trailing newline; case_sha256_table_sha256 = sha256(json.dumps({id: sha}, sort_keys=True)); prompt.assembled_sha256 is over the text sent (one trailing newline removed), prompt.file_sha256 over the file bytes. Null fields are filled by the runner.

options.started_aborted_scoring: not scored; listed unscored (started-aborted/<case>.json). Each gate keeps score.py's own denominator; G7 uses planned cases. Recorded, started-aborted and never-started counts are reported next to every gate.

retry_repair.model_call_failure: recorded with its receipt, forced escalate, no retry; under the Haiku cost cap a failed call that reports no cost stops the run (cost_unreported) and a CLI budget stop is a cost-cap abort

haiku.cost_cap_enforcement: remaining budget before each call; failed-call cost and tokens counted and kept; unreported cost stops the run; overshoot or unreported cost on any call (the last included) is a limit violation (exit 3); the CLI stopping at the lowered budget is a cost-cap abort (started-aborted)

qwen.wall_cap_enforcement: absolute deadline from before preflight; checked before every call and case; no call started unless its 120 s timeout plus the 180 s cleanup reserve fits; an overrun is a wall_cap_exceeded limit violation (exit 3)

context_overflow: not prevented; flagged per turn from reported counts and from the estimate; all recorded cases scored as recorded; two subset rows (no reported flag; no reported and no estimate flag); estimate-only flags labelled possibly truncated; no rerun
amendment_1: Rebased onto main 34e8589e (PR #1025, guard-v3 support from typed execution; EPUB execution vs damage) before any model response. Only frozen_code_commit, base_main_commit and frozen_src_tree_sha1 changed; every hash, model, cap and rule is as first committed (d1c87066).
amendment_2: Pre-measurement review (Opus, Astra 12) before any model response: prompt v5 text changed, enforced caps, started-aborted records, registered warm-up, enforced digest. Changed: prompt hashes, frozen_code_commit, frozen_src_tree_sha1, claude config timeout_s, qwen --require-digest. Everything else as in amendment_1.
amendment_3: Re-check of e43db99e (Opus, Astra 13) before any model response: failed-call receipts kept, denominator wording, final-call limit violations, wall cleanup reserve, CLI budget abort. Changed: frozen_code_commit, frozen_src_tree_sha1. Prompt hashes unchanged.
gates_note: G10 = records passing score.py's G10 checks / records written (digest or not-applicable reason, response id, runtime version, harness commit, config hash, fixture hashes, raw I/O). Estimate-flag subset (b) is at most 44 of 73 cases (Opus: the estimate flags 29).
